Japanese word of the day共生 · きょうせい · kyōsei

Living together; coexistence. 共 means “together,” while 生 means “life” or “to live.” In Japan, kyōsei shakai (共生社会) is common in public policy and disability discussions: a society in which people participate without being separated by barriers.

Example: 共生社会をつくる—“to build an inclusive society.” Today’s Asian Para Games story asks what must remain after the ceremony for that phrase to become daily practice. Learn Japanese in context with DraMap for iOS.
